commit.message: fix(governance): keep large manual PRs out of diff deadlock

intent: Repair the required automerge tier-policy check so an unlabeled or draft operator-manual PR remains a deterministic pass even when GitHub refuses to render a diff larger than 20,000 lines. Preserve fail-closed full evidence gathering for canary PRs and every caller that explicitly assumes unattended authority.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('scripts/governance/check_automerge_tier_policy.py'); t=p.read_text(); old='and (not (UNATTENDED_LABELS & set(labels)) or is_draft)'; new='and True'; (t.count(old) == 1) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(old,new,1)); sys.exit(1 if '--assume-unattended' in p.read_text() else 2)"
negative_controls.name: unattended-large-diff-still-fails-closed

honest_blockers: This change does not authorize unattended merging. Canary and --assume-unattended calls still require all authenticated review, files, diff, and rate evidence and fail closed on any partial read.
interface_mismatches: The required policy workflow invokes gh pr diff before deciding whether the PR is in the unattended lane; GitHub returns HTTP 406 for diffs over 20,000 lines, wedging manual draft PRs the policy says must pass.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this packet-scoped repair; large manual PRs will again require an operator override when GitHub refuses their diff.
